This indicates that Dipropyl-4-hydroxytryptamine may influence ERK through the intermediate of the Gamma-aminobutyric acid receptor subunit delta. The evidence suggests a possible regulatory mechanism where Dipropyl-4-hydroxytryptamine could modulate ERK activity via the GABA receptor pathway.
